verdict.rationale: Docs describe off-cycle payrolls as a mechanism for 'corrections' and show that upcoming payrolls can be retrieved with an 'unprocessed' status, implying a pre-payment window, but there is no explicit documentation of a cancel/void/edit endpoint for a submitted payroll before it is paid. Missing for 10: explicit cancel/void payroll API, documented workflow for editing an already-submitted-but-unprocessed payroll, and independent confirmation this works in practice.
